rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for being serious or earnest rather than joking.

example.english: I'm being serious when I tell you this.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 jing6 zan1 gam2 tung4 nei5 gong2 gaa3

rows.note: Use this when “serious” means important or significant, without necessarily implying danger or severity.

example.english: This is serious; it is very important to the company.
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 deoi3 gung1 si1 hou2 zung6 jiu3

rows.note: Use this for a serious problem or situation when the emphasis is on severity or bad consequences.

example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 lau6 seoi2 man6 tai4 hou2 jim4 zung6

rows.note: Use this for a grave, solemn manner or expression, especially when someone is not light-hearted.

example.english: They become very serious as soon as they talk about this matter.
example.traditional: 佢一講到呢件事，就即刻變得好嚴肅。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 gong2 dou3 ni1 gin6 si6 zau6 zik1 hak1 bin3 dak1 hou2 jim4 suk1
